rootCauseClosed.defectOnC0: diagnoseMetaLiveCollector set provenanceVerified = Boolean(actualQueryAttempted && upstreamQueryCompleted), which evaluated to true even when rawAdsReturned === 0 (zero upstream ads observed). It also lacked explicit transportStatus and contentStatus fields.
rootCauseClosed.fixInC1: provenanceVerified is now strictly Boolean(actualQueryAttempted && upstreamQueryCompleted && rawAdsReturned > 0). Added explicit transportStatus (SKIPPED_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY | QUERY_ATTEMPTED_EMPTY_OR_BLOCKED | QUERY_COMPLETED_WITH_ADS | COLLECTOR_DISABLED | PYTHON_RUNTIME_MISSING) and contentStatus (NO_QUERY_EXECUTED | ZERO_ADS_RETURNED | UPSTREAM_ADS_OBSERVED).
